scope: Execution kernel and resource budget only; this file does not declare a programme bank or TEST selection frozen.
budget_clock: CPU; parent process plus measured native child CPU
common_seed: Complete feasible static weighted-degree schedule, with loading and seed construction charged
destroy_cycle: alternating, same preregistered random stream seed across heads
objective_transport: Original integer microsecond ticks, no rounding or scaling
station_gap: Actual root contact antenna constraint, not a minimum or average
deadline_scope: Nominal optimization CPU deadline is soft. Legal fallback completion and final feasibility validation finish after interruption; actual CPU, wall time, native child CPU and encoding cost are recorded.
encoding_scope: One measured complete JSON encoding pass reported separately; output file transport and controller process startup are outside optimizer deadline.
acceptance_guard: Positive gain over incumbent only, while retaining raw proposals, negative deltas, failures and score/commit counters.
TEST_requirement: Separate frozen protocol, exact final programme-bank SHA and final_program_ids; no online calls or programme changes on TEST.
